ops.title: Cleanup busy readmission should retain an allowed active deletion
ops.description: Owner: Yasyf Mohamedali. Next step: use per-job gate policy in readmit instead of global holds. Evidence at 60eefaf1b: engine.go:1281 parks any active deletion whenever the gate holds, even if rests(job) is false and Readmit returned the same root. Default Readmit is 10 seconds at line 148; the next slice reopens via Admit, and relocate/inplace.go:658-677 runs residue Git checks that Readmit normally avoids. This adds repeated full proof work while sessions are busy. Source-only review; no tests ran.

ops.text: A free job with a stable root remains open across successful Readmit under an unstrained held gate.
Protected or strained jobs and changed, blocked, or completed roots still park; downstream validation checks no extra Admit for a stable allowed root.
